items.description: Cybersecurity project and community that promotes information security knowledge aligned with current technology trends and the industry.
bullets: Cybersecurity project and community that shares information-security knowledge aligned with current technology trends and the industry.
Web platform with a Golang backend and a React frontend, deployed on Digital Ocean.
Includes an AI agent that supports users with questions about services and training.
Content on cybersecurity, ethical hacking, DevSecOps, tutorials, proofs of concept and vulnerabilities.

items.description: Portal built to train Bold's development teams in security best practices and secure software design.
items.note: Project owned by Bold. Some implementation details remain confidential.
bullets: Portal that trains Bold's development teams in secure coding practices and secure software design, used to renew the PCI DSS certification.
Full-stack development with a Golang and Python backend on AWS Serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, ECS, ECR).
Creation of secure coding guidelines and practices for the company's serverless technology stack (Python, CDK, AWS).

items.description: Security anomaly detection system built and maintained at Mercado Libre, focused on observability and early response to unusual behavior in the infrastructure.
items.note: Project owned by Mercado Libre. Source code is confidential and not publicly available.
bullets: Design, development and refactoring of scalable microservices and APIs in Golang and Python to enrich the solution's anomaly detection systems (a distributed system).
Design of architecture improvements for the solution and definition of monitoring and observability thresholds for some of its APIs.
Early response to malicious traffic with AWS WAF and AWS Shield; the case was documented in an AWS architecture blog article.

items.description: RESTful microservice for managing football tournament data. Uses AWS resources provisioned and deployed with Terraform.
Generates the scaffold of a secure Golang REST API from a domain model specification. Integrated with Google Gemini.
CLI to simulate malicious behavior in Kubernetes clusters. Includes two security incident scenarios involving privilege escalation and malware execution.
bullets: CLI built in Golang with Cobra (github.com/spf13/cobra) to automatically run malicious behavior vectors and vulnerability exploitation.
Deployment of a command and control (C&C) server that receives post-exploitation information.
Two red teaming scenarios (Malware Infection and Hunting) that demonstrate the detection capabilities of Falco Runtime Security.

items.description: Deliberately vulnerable REST API built in Go, demonstrating common security vulnerabilities including SQL Injection (SQLi) and Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR).
bullets: Research and implementation of a deliberately vulnerable REST API in Golang, with vulnerabilities such as IDOR, SQL Injection, JWT misconfiguration, Broken Authentication and Path Traversal, among others.
Identification and documentation of the malicious payloads that exploit the application.

items.description: Real-time detection demo for CVE-2023-4911 (Looney Tunables) using Falco runtime security rules.
bullets: Demo of a detection scenario with Falco Runtime Security for CVE-2023-4911 (Looney Tunables), using blasty's exploit and Meterpreter to escalate privileges in a vulnerable pod inside a Kubernetes cluster.
Falcosidekick and Falcosidekick UI to centralize the security events generated by malicious activity.
Custom Falco rules to detect other malicious behaviors such as privilege escalation, malware execution, credential access and data exfiltration, among others.
Incident management flow with a Slack webhook and a Python automation that filters events by severity and handles escalation.

items.description: Implements a classical cryptanalysis of the Vigenère cipher using the Kasiski test and frequency analysis.
Security monitoring REST API that enriches AWS CloudTrail logs with IP geolocation.
Conversational AI agent for a tech store that tracks orders in real time: the LLM detects the customer's intent, calls a tool and answers with the actual order status.
bullets: Order tracking agent: the customer asks "where is my order?" and the LLM detects the intent and runs the get_order_status tool against the real database instead of answering from static documents.
Tool-calling flow with OpenAI Function Calling: the backend declares the tools, the model decides which one to call, the backend runs it and the model writes the final answer.
Golang backend with tools served over MCP and data in PostgreSQL.
Designed to grow into stock and reservations, active post-sales support (RAG + tickets), cross-selling and semantic product search.

items.description: Multi-agent customer support lab: a supervisor routes each request to specialist agents with RAG, MCP tools over a simulated CRM, guardrails and observability.
bullets: Multi-agent graph with LangGraph: guardrails, supervisor, specialists (knowledge, transactions, human handoff) and a final quality check.
RAG with LangChain and pgvector; tools exposed through an MCP server in Go over a simulated CRM (fictional data).
Go REST API (chi) with controller → service → repository layers, plus a Python FastAPI agent service.
React + TypeScript chat with a trace panel showing agents, tools and sources used.
Observability with LangSmith, evaluation with a golden dataset and risk analysis based on the OWASP LLM Top 10.
